answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, re-queued for a second panel, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. By the horizon of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The forge lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the violet is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
